title: ProteinLock — L99A Molecular Docking
description: Search for a small molecule that fits into a tiny pocket inside a well-studied test protein called T4 lysozyme L99A, then compare the result with published reference data.

progress.label: Search progress
progress.help: How many candidate molecules have at least one complete search result in the current run.
progress.throughput_help: How quickly complete molecule results are arriving from the fleet. It measures compute speed, not scientific quality.

best.label: Top prediction
best.help: This is the molecule ProteinLock predicts fits the pocket best among the candidates tested. The name is an anonymous benchmark ID, so the search does not use published answers while ranking candidates. In this checkpoint PL-C06 is the one candidate without a published yes/no class, so it remains an open prediction rather than a confirmed binder.

metrics.label: Search checked
metrics.help: ProteinLock tested this many molecules and this many total positions and rotations inside the pocket.

metrics.label: Search convergence
metrics.help: The fleet search stops only after every molecule has gone at least the patience window without finding a better pose. This is our practical 'nothing better is appearing anymore' rule, similar to PaperPlane convergence.

metrics.label: Pose accuracy
metrics.help: For the reference molecule, this measures how far ProteinLock's predicted position is from the published measured position. Smaller is better; below 2 Å passes this checkpoint.

metrics.label: Ranking test
metrics.help: We know which checkpoint molecules should fit and which should not. ProteinLock correctly placed the known fitting molecule above the known non-fitting molecule in 12 of 14 pair checks. This is the plain-language version of AUC 0.857.

metrics.label: Known answers
metrics.help: The published checkpoint gives us 7 known fitting cases and 2 known non-fitting cases. One of the 10 candidates has no yes/no class in the checkpoint and is therefore treated as an open prediction.

metrics.label: Validation
metrics.help: PASS means three simple checks succeeded: the search settled, the reference pose was close enough to the measured pose, and known fitting molecules were ranked above known non-fitting ones often enough.

details.window_note: Maximum number of Microgrid tasks in flight.
